name: hashdeep
description: Digital forensics hashing suite with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, Tiger, and Whirlpool support

hashdeep.description: Recursive file hashing tool for digital forensics and integrity verification
hashdeep.usage: hashdeep -r /path/to/investigate # Recursive hashing\nhashdeep -c baseline.txt # Compare against baseline

md5deep.description: Specialized MD5 hash calculator for forensic analysis and file verification
md5deep.usage: md5deep -r /evidence # Recursive MD5 hashing\nmd5deep -m known_md5.txt *.bin # Match against known MD5s

sha256deep.description: SHA-256 hash calculator for modern cryptographic file verification
sha256deep.usage: sha256deep -r /secure/files # Recursive SHA-256 hashing\nsha256deep -m hashes.sha256 /download # Verify downloads
